Module info5.sar
Package info5.sar.EventBasedChannel.Impl

Class Broker

java.lang.Object
info5.sar.EventBasedChannel.Impl.Broker
All Implemented Interfaces:
IBroker
public class Broker extends Object implements IBroker
The Broker class implements the IBroker interface and represents a broker that manages connections and bindings for different ports.

This class is responsible for registering itself with the BrokerManager, binding and unbinding ports with listeners, and handling connection requests to other brokers.

It maintains a map of port numbers to IAcceptListener instances, which are used to handle incoming connections on specific ports.

When a connection request is made, the broker checks if the requested port is bound and, if so, establishes a communication channel between the connecting party and the bound listener.

If the port is not bound, the connection request is retried a limited number of times before being refused.

Methods:

  • Broker(String) - Constructs a Broker with the specified name and registers it with the BrokerManager.
  • unbind(int) - Unbinds the listener from the specified port.
  • bind(int, IAcceptListener) - Binds a listener to the specified port.
  • connect(String, int, IConnectListener) - Attempts to connect to another broker on the specified port.
  • name() - Returns the name of the broker.

Private Methods:

  • _connect(int, IConnectListener) - Handles the connection logic for the specified port.

Fields:

  • _brokerManager - The BrokerManager instance managing this broker.
  • _name - The name of the broker.
  • _binds - A map of port numbers to IAcceptListener instances.
